name: bloop-drop
description: Bloop Drop: a one-thumb endless faller with in-app purchases and ads.

scripts.cap:add:android: npm run build && npx cap add android
scripts.cap:add:ios: npm run build && npx cap add ios
scripts.sync: npm run build && npx cap sync
scripts.android: npm run sync && npx cap open android
scripts.ios: npm run sync && npx cap open ios
